reviewSamples.author: Photo of Stephanie Rivera
reviewSamples.text: I’ve been getting my lashes done by Morgan since 2024, and she’s the only person I trust with them! When I first started, I was nervous about getting my lashes done, but Morgan made the whole experience so comfortable. She’s incredibly patient, understanding, and always accommodating—especially since I have autism. If I ever feel any discomfort, she immediately makes adjustments to ensure I’m comfortable. Her space is always clean and professional, and it’s been amazing to watch her business grow over time. I always leave feeling confident and cared for! Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a lash artist who truly goes above and beyond.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Lexie Burkett
reviewSamples.text: Zoey gives the most relaxing and refreshing facials—I always leave feeling amazing. She’s also my go-to for waxing and shaping, and the results are flawless every time (seriously, it still surprises me!). She takes the time to explain each step and delivers truly high-quality care. I already can’t wait for my next appointment!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Bianca Gonzales
reviewSamples.text: Morgan did an excellent job with my eyebrows. I love them so much! I'm definitely recommending her! 💕🫶

reviewSamples.author: Photo of LeighAnn Landers
reviewSamples.text: Zoey was very professional, kind, and clean! A very cute little shop and great at what she does! Will definitely be back! I got my underarms waxed for the first time.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Taniah Marc
reviewSamples.text: Morgan made my first time with her AMAZING! She asked detailed questions before we even started and the color match?? PERFECTTTTT. Highly recommend will be back everything from the lash to the brows was amazing
